key_concepts: Earth is an oblate spheroid, slightly flattened at the poles and bulging at the equator.
The equator is the 0° latitude line that divides Earth into Northern and Southern Hemisphe
Earth's axis is tilted about 23.5 degrees.
Earth rotates on its axis from west to east.
One full rotation of Earth takes 24 hours.
Earth's rotation causes day and night because only half of Earth faces the Sun at a time.
The apparent daily movement of the Sun and Moon across the sky is connected to Earth's rot
Earth revolves around the Sun in an elliptical orbit, while the Moon orbits Earth.
Solar eclipses occur when the Moon passes between the Sun and Earth.
Lunar eclipses occur when Earth passes between the Moon and the Sun.
Earth's revolution around the Sun causes seasons.
